cd /app && python3 -c "
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
ds = load_dataset('ryanmarten/OpenThoughts-1k-sample','metadata',split='train')
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct')
science={'physics','chemistry','biology'}
sub=[r for r in ds if r['domain'] in science]
print('rows',len(sub))
def ntok(t): return len(tok(t,add_special_tokens=False)['input_ids']) if t else 0
reas=sum(ntok(r['deepseek_reasoning']) for r in sub)
sol=sum(ntok(r['deepseek_solution']) for r in sub)
print('reasoning',reas,'solution',sol,'sum',reas+sol)
" 2>&1 | tail -20
